apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Issue scoped bearer tokens and attach roles or policies to shape data access.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to grant machine access.

errors.conflicts: Policy conflicts must be resolved before attaching.

apiKeys.allowedOriginsHelp: One per line. Empty means any origin. Requests without an origin — native or server-side callers — are always allowed, so this is not a defence against curl.
apiKeys.confirmRemoveOrigins: Remove the origin allowlist? This key will then work from any website.

preview.title: Effective permission preview
preview.description: Policy rows reachable through direct policies and attached roles.

form.name: Name
form.publishable: Publishable (safe to embed in a browser or app)
form.publishableHelp: Issues an lbk_pub_… token. It is not a secret — anyone who loads your app can read it, so scope it as if it were already public. Buys per-key quota, rotation and audit, not confidentiality.
form.allowedOriginsHelp: Blocks other websites from using this key in a browser. Leave empty for no constraint. Requests without an origin — native or server-side callers — are always allowed, so this is not a defence against curl.

importExport.title: Import / export
importExport.description: Move roles, policies, bindings, and API key access metadata between environments.

capabilities.portableText: JSON includes access refs and binding priorities.
capabilities.dryRunText: Review diff, warnings, and blocking conflicts before writes.
capabilities.auditedText: Successful imports refresh access queries after the apply response.

errors.notManifest: Selected file is not a HeoPress access manifest.

dialog.title: Import access manifest
dialog.description: Dry-run runs immediately after a valid JSON file is selected.

merge.label: Merge
merge.hint: Upsert managed refs and keep existing access rows.

replaceManaged.label: Replace managed
replaceManaged.hint: Replace refs present in the manifest.

replaceAll.label: Replace all
replaceAll.hint: Replace all importable access rows for this site.

dryRun.passedBody: No blocking conflicts or validation errors.

publicAccess.intro: Grant content access to visitors who are not staff. Anything not listed here is denied — both realms start empty.
publicAccess.noCollections: This site has no content collections yet. Create one before granting access to it.
publicAccess.publicWarning: Anyone on the internet can read what is checked below, with no credential. A token in your frontend does not change that — treat these grants as fully public.
publicAccess.off: Public access is off. Unauthenticated requests are rejected. Enable it to choose what visitors may read.

layout.title: Access control
layout.description: Roles bundle policies; policies bundle permission rules. Use the matrix to audit and the sandbox to debug a verdict.

content.label: Content collections
content.hint: Project content and custom collections returned by the schema API.

schema.label: Schema builder
schema.hint: Collections, fields, and relations that shape the data model.

access.label: Access control
access.hint: Roles, policies, bindings, and permission rows.

extension.label: Extension access
extension.hint: Extension install/configure grants, module visibility, endpoints, and operations.

sensitive.label: Sensitive system
sensitive.hint: Security state, audit trails, backup codes, and API key metadata.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Each user has one primary role per site. Assign policies to roles to grant collection permissions.
roles.emptyBody: Create a role to start assigning permissions.
roles.appAccessHint: App access (members can sign in to Studio)

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Each policy bundles permission rows (collection × action). Attach policies to roles or users; lower priority runs first.
policies.emptyBody: Create a policy and add permission rules to it.

roleDetail.conflictsBlock: Policy conflicts must be resolved before attaching.
roleDetail.adminAccessHint: Bypass all permission checks for members.
roleDetail.appAccessHint: Members can sign in to Studio.
roleDetail.noMembers: No users assigned yet. Provide a user id below to assign one.

policyDetail.rowsHint: Each row grants (collection, action) with optional row-level rules, field whitelist, validation, and presets.
policyDetail.noRows: No permissions yet. Add one to grant access.

guards.title: Guardrails
guards.hint: Time-bound + IP allow/deny evaluated before any permission row.

policyDetail.sensitiveHidden: Sensitive system collections are hidden unless your current principal has admin bypass.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.description: Compiled bundle for the current principal. Click a cell to inspect.
matrix.adminActive: Admin bypass active — every cell allowed

inspector.admin: Admin bypass — all fields, no rule restriction.
inspector.compiled: Compiled from one or more permission rows on attached policies.

sandbox.notObject: Item payload must be a JSON object.
sandbox.title: Test sandbox
sandbox.description: Simulate a verdict for the active principal. Send an optional item payload to evaluate row-level rules.

rowEditor.topLevelObject: Top-level value must be a JSON object.
rowEditor.nested: This rule uses _or / _not nesting. Switch to JSON mode to edit it.
rowEditor.noConditions: No conditions — anyone with this row can pass the rule check.
